title: The Letters of Rosewater Lane
author: A. M. Pemberton
blurb: Astrid Winterbourne, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
